intents_zh: jq 探索 JSON 路徑
code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

F="{{input_file}}"

echo "=== leaf paths with types ==="
jq -r '
  paths(scalars) as $p
  | [($p | map(tostring) | join(".")), (getpath($p) | type)]
  | @tsv
' "$F" | sort -u

echo ""
echo "=== sample values ==="
jq -r '
  paths(scalars) as $p
  | [($p | map(tostring) | join(".")), (getpath($p) | tojson)]
  | @tsv
' "$F" | head -50
summary_zh: jq 列 JSON 所有 leaf path + type + 樣本
